project: Agricultural Field Carbon Credit Estimation using coupling of Satellite Embeddings and RAG

legacy_artifacts.reason: Trained on the synthetic US-crop reference dataset; not valid for Haryana classification.

promotion_requirements: Haryana field-verified training and independent holdout labels
Documented spatial and temporal leakage controls
Per-class precision, recall, F1, and uncertainty reporting
Independent validation of burn-scar signals against field and/or accepted reference observations
A separately approved carbon methodology before any credit or emissions claim
